subject: science
passage: Mulch is a layer of material spread over soil to slow the loss of water. Gardener Rosa Delgado covered four garden beds in Tucson, Arizona, with different mulches and left a fifth bed bare. Two days after watering all five beds, she measured how much water remained in the soil of each. Her results show that the soil held the most water under ______

data.title: Soil Moisture Two Days after Watering

stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?

choices.A: bare soil, where soil moisture was about 11 percent.
choices.B: wood chips, which also kept weeds from growing in the bed.
choices.C: cardboard, where soil moisture was about 22 percent.
choices.D: straw, where soil moisture was about 24 percent.

explanation.why: The statement asks which covering left the most water in the soil, so look for the tallest bar. The straw bar, at about 24 percent, is taller than all the others.
explanation.A: Incorrect. Bare soil held the least water of the five beds, not the most.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The graph shows only soil moisture; it gives no information about weeds.
explanation.C: Incorrect. Cardboard did keep about 22 percent moisture, but that is less than straw's 24 percent.
explanation.D: Correct. The soil under straw held about 24 percent moisture, the highest value on the graph.
